title: Design System: DeFi Garden — Night Instrument Panel

display.purpose: The landing headline only. Barlow Condensed 600.

title.purpose: The selected pool's symbol on the instrument plate; 26px when narrow.

readout.purpose: Digital value in each dial face; the same condensed tabular face sets scale numerals, row scores, APY and ranks.

placard.purpose: Instrument labels, list title, lamp labels, column headers. The only uppercase in the system.

label.purpose: Meta lines, footnotes, chain badges, tab labels.

code.purpose: The MCP install command only; the one monospace use.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The mobile menu sheet, the only floating element.

shadows.name: fastener-ring
shadows.purpose: Dark ring around each plate screw.

shadows.name: lamp-well
shadows.purpose: Recessed hairline of an unlit annunciator lamp.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every :focus-visible in the landing; never removed or recoloured.

motion.name: needle-swing
motion.purpose: Damped needle rotation when a reading changes; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Tabs, nav links, outlined buttons, the primary action.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Mobile menu sheet, 6px drop-in; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Physical press on every control. No scale transforms.

components.css: .ds-open { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; background: var(--ip-green, #7CFF9E); color: var(--ip-on-green, #04130A); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-open:hover { background: var(--ip-green-hover, #A6FFBE); } .ds-open:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2F5F5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Category filters with tabular counts; active is green-soft.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; background: #111316; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; background: transparent; color: #AEB6B9; border: 1px solid #363B41; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab span { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #848D91; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #F2F5F5; border-color: #848D91; } .ds-tab:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tab.is-active { color: #7CFF9E; border-color: rgba(124,255,158,0.45); background: rgba(124,255,158,0.10); } .ds-tab.is-active span { color: #7CFF9E; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2F5F5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ranked List Row
components.description: Rank, pool with chain badge, score over rating, APY with trend.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0,1fr) 76px 92px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #111316; color: #F2F5F5; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #24282D; text-align: left; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: #16191D; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2F5F5; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rank { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #848D91; } .ds-id { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; } .ds-sym { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.5px; } .ds-meta { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; color: #848D91; } .ds-chain { padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid #363B41; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 17px; color: #AEB6B9; } .ds-grade { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-score { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rating { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #7CFF9E; } .ds-apy { text-align: right; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Dial
components.description: The one dial grammar: 240-degree sweep, two-step bezel, graduated scale, coloured bands, green needle, digital readout, placard.
components.css: .ds-gauge { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 16px; background: #111316; } .ds-dial { width: 184px; } .ds-dial .b { fill: #15181C; stroke: #2B2F34; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-dial .bs { fill: none; stroke: #33383E; stroke-width: 1; } .ds-dial .f { fill: #090B0D; } .ds-dial .arc { fill: none; stroke-width: 7; opacity: 0.9; } .ds-dial .r { stroke: #FF5A4F; } .ds-dial .a { stroke: #FFB000; } .ds-dial .g { stroke: #7CFF9E; } .ds-dial .t { stroke: #F2F5F5; stroke-width: 2.2; } .ds-dial .s { fill: #F2F5F5; font: 600 16px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; } .ds-dial .n { fill: #7CFF9E; transform-origin: 100px 100px; transform-box: view-box; transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-dial .h { fill: #1C1F23; stroke: #40464C; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-dial .ro { fill: #F2F5F5; font: 600 23px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dial .sro { fill: #AEB6B9; font: 500 12.5px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-anchor: middle; } .ds-placard { padding: 3px 10px; border: 1px solid #363B41; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #AEB6B9; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dial .n { transition: none; } }

narrative.northStar: Trust the instruments when you can't see outside.
narrative.overview:
The system is a small-aircraft instrument panel at night. Black plates hold instrument faces; white scales and numerals sit on near-black dials; a radium-green needle reads each value; amber and red appear only where a pilot would need caution. Every instrument is bound to one real number from CI-computed or live DefiLlama data, so the panel is a reading, never an illustration. It refuses both the hero-then-cards landing and the neon crypto dashboard.

Density is cockpit density: a ranked list and a six-instrument panel share the first viewport, and nothing floats that does not have to. Depth is made from plate steps and hairlines, never from glow or soft shadow. Motion is mechanical: a damped needle swing when a reading changes, short colour transitions on controls, nothing that bounces or scales.

This world is the design authority going forward (PRODUCT.md, 2026-09-27). It is currently built on the landing (bare `/`) only, which is dark-only and ignores the site theme toggle. See "Surfaces not yet migrated" at the end.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only panel: black plates, near-black instrument faces, white scales.
One luminous green for needles, normal-range arcs, lit "normal" lamps, the selected state and the single primary action.
Amber and red are reserved for caution and warning bands, and for the snapshot-data lamp.
One dial grammar for every round gauge (240° sweep, two-step bezel, graduated scale, digital readout).
Barlow Condensed for display, readouts and placards; Barlow for text; caps only on placards.
Hairline plates with four screws; no blur, no glow, no drop shadows at rest.

rules.name: The Luminous-Is-Colour Rule
rules.body: "Luminous" means a saturated colour on black, never a blur. No `filter: blur`, no glowing `box-shadow`, no text-shadow halo on any needle, arc, lamp or button.

rules.name: The Caution-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber and red appear only where the data means caution or warning (a band, a lit lamp, a falling trend, snapshot data). Never as decoration, never as a brand accent.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "normal, selected, or go". Every green on screen is one of those three; there is no second accent.

rules.name: The Placard Rule
rules.body: Uppercase exists only on instrument placards: gauge labels, the list title, lamp labels, column headers. Everything else, including buttons, tabs and headlines, is sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (score, APY, rank, TVL, counts, scale labels) is set in the condensed face with `tabular-nums`, so readings do not jitter as values update.

rules.name: The List-First Rule
rules.body: Below 900px the list is the page. There is no side panel: a tapped row expands its own instrument panel inline beneath it (`aria-expanded`), the screws are dropped, and the primary action goes full width. The list shows the top 10 with a "show all" control; the tabs become a single horizontally scrolling line with an edge fade.

rules.name: The Shared Viewport Rule
rules.body: On desktop the ranked list and the reading of the selected pool are always visible together; selecting a row never navigates.

rules.name: The Plate-Step Rule
rules.body: To lift something, step its background (face → plate → plate-raised) and give it a hairline. Never a drop shadow, never a glow.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Exactly one filled button exists per panel; everything else is outlined or text.

dos: Do bind every needle, arc, lamp and readout to a real number from CI or live data, and give each instrument a text equivalent (aria-label).
Do use the dial grammar exactly: 240° sweep, two-step bezel, four minor graduations per major, 5° minimum arc span, damped needle, no motion under reduced-motion.
Do keep one filled green action per panel ("Open pool") and make everything else outlined or text.
Do build depth from face / plate / plate-raised steps and 1px hairlines.
Do set every changing number in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals.
Do keep caps on placards only.
Do go list-first below 900px: rows expand their panel inline, top 10 plus "show all".
donts: Don't make anything glow: no blur, no glow shadows, no text halos. Luminous is colour on black.
Don't draw a decorative gauge, fake needle, or placeholder reading; show an honest empty state instead.
Don't use amber or red for anything but caution and warning.
Don't add a second accent colour or a second filled button.
Don't use scale-pop hovers or bounce easings; controls press down 1px on active.
Don't add a light theme to this world's landing; it is dark-only.
Don't use monospace anywhere except a literal command to copy.
